{{Ireland Native}}

== Biography ==
'''Margaret Glasgow''' was born in Ireland on 17 October 1810, a daughter of [[Glasgow-822|John Glasgow]] and [[Arthur-2480|Mary Arthur]]. The date is written in John and Mary's family register.<ref name="GlasgowBible">Glasgow family Bible, family register of [[Glasgow-822|John Glasgow]] and [[Arthur-2480|Mary Arthur]], [https://hiltner.com/mckeown/histories/8479.jpeg original register image]; [https://hiltner.com/mckeown/showmedia.php?mediaID=532&medialinkID=726 media description], ''McKeown and Shields Families''; the collection is indexed at [https://hiltner.com/mckeown/index.php hiltner.com/mckeown], accessed 29 August 2026.</ref>

Margaret married [[Walkinshaw-5|John Henry Walkinshaw]]. In 1860 she was recorded in John's household in Yellow Spring Township, Des Moines County, Iowa; the census gave her birthplace as Ireland.<ref name="Census1860">“United States Census, 1860,” database with images, FamilySearch ([https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:M82V-XZ2 M82V-XZ2], accessed 29 August 2026), Margaret Walkinshaw in the household of John Walkinshaw, Yellow Spring Township, Des Moines County, Iowa, United States.</ref>

Her gravestone records that she died on 12 November 1860, aged 50, and was buried in Sharon Cemetery, Des Moines County.<ref name="Memorial">[https://www.findagrave.com/memorial/19859751/margaret-walkinshaw Find a Grave memorial 19859751, Margaret Glasgow Walkinshaw], including gravestone photograph and transcription, accessed 29 August 2026.</ref>

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-822]] is assessed at 98% (proved). John Glasgow and Mary Arthur’s family Bible includes Margaret, born 17 October 1810, among the nine children after their 21 May 1798 marriage. The Bible date supersedes the 23 October memorial date without changing the father.

Selected father-profile identity and paternal relationship; maternal identity is separate.

Next useful test: Compare the register hand/entry with associated correspondence or baptism.

Source basis already held: [https://hiltner.com/mckeown/histories/8479.jpeg Glasgow family Bible, family register of John Glasgow and Mary Arthur, original register image (https://hiltner.com/mckeown/histories/8479.jpeg); media description (https://hiltner.com/mckeown/showmedia.php?mediaID=532&medialinkID=726), McKeown and Shields Families; the collection is indexed at hiltner.com/mckeown (https://hiltner.com/mckeown/index.php), accessed 29 August 2026.]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.


The memorial gives Margaret's birth as 23 October 1810. The original family register gives 17 October 1810, so the register date is used here. The memorial is relied on for the gravestone death and burial details, not for the conflicting birth date.
